english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had unlawful sexual intercourse with **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a girl under the age of 13
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5 of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) See also offence wording: H543 - relating to USI with a girl under 16.
(ii) This offence is included in Schedule 1 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must comply with the requirements of Section 2 of that Act.
(iii) This offence is included in Schedule 2 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person committing this offence outside the United Kingdom may in certain circumstances be prosecuted for that offence in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
(iv) IMPORTANT - Officers should carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(v) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:

See Note (iv) above re increase in penalty
